name: Dreamy Town Majo Sandra
source:
On Sunday, I made a promise to date. When I entered the coffee shop her body began to get distorted suddenly and I understood that she was a witch. Now I'm dragged into her world and need to find her to get back.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
周日，我约好和她见面。我一走进咖啡店，她的身体突然扭曲变形，我这才明白她是个魔女。如今我被拖进了她的世界，必须找到她才能回去。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
